title: BPP-Search: Enhancing Tree of Thought Reasoning for Mathematical Modeling Problem Solving
authors_zh: Teng Wang、Wing-Yin Yu、Zhenqi He、Zehua Liu、Hailei Gong、Han Wu、Xiongwei Han、Wei Shi、Ruifeng She、Fangzhou Zhu、Tao Zhong
paper_type_zh: 树搜索方法与最终结构化数据集发布
best_for_zh: 研究测试时树搜索、过程奖励模型、候选选择器、运筹优化推理数据与发布审计的读者
one_line: BPP-Search uses a learned process reward model to prune a mathematical-modeling tree and a pairwise classifier to select the final candidate, while the public StructuredOR artifact contains 124 final structured examples rather than the raw search trees.
BPP-Search 用学习式过程奖励模型剪枝数学建模树，再用成对偏好分类器选择最终候选；公开的 StructuredOR 仅含 124 条最终结构化样例，而不含原始搜索树。
why: It makes tree width, intermediate scoring, and final-candidate selection explicit data-construction variables, but also demonstrates why a final question and label release cannot support audits of rejected branches, selector behavior, verifier outputs, or inference-budget attribution.
inclusion_reason: BPP-Search is a direct tree-search and selector study for mathematical-modeling reasoning: it exposes a PRM-guided beam substrate, pairwise final-candidate selection, and explicit search budgets, while its final-only StructuredOR release makes the missing raw-tree boundary especially important for this track.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Operations-research language models must convert a natural-language problem into a mathematical program whose sets, parameters, variables, objective, and constraints are mutually consistent. Earlier public resources used by this work often expose only the problem and objective value, leaving the intermediate modeling decisions unavailable for supervision or diagnosis. The paper addresses this annotation gap with StructuredOR and separately studies how to search over intermediate modeling decisions with BPP-Search.

For the rollout/search track, the key problem is also a release-boundary problem. BPP-Search reasons over a branching Q -> SP -> V -> OC tree, scores intermediate nodes, prunes candidates, and ranks a final queue. A final answer alone cannot reveal which alternatives were explored, why a branch was rejected, whether a verifier failed, or how much inference budget produced the selected model. The official release therefore has to be read as final structured examples, not as a public corpus of BPP-Search trajectories.

运筹优化建模要求模型把自然语言问题转成数学规划，并保持集合、参数、变量、目标函数和约束相互一致。本文所用的既有公开资源往往只给出问题与目标值，中间建模决策无法用于监督或诊断。论文一方面以 StructuredOR 补充结构化标注，另一方面用 BPP-Search 研究如何在中间建模决策上进行搜索。

对“Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data”方向而言，这同时也是一个发布边界问题。BPP-Search 在 Q -> SP -> V -> OC 的分支树上推理，对中间节点打分、剪枝，并对最终候选队列排序。仅保留最终答案无法说明搜索过哪些替代方案、某个分支为何被淘汰、验证器是否失败，或选中模型消耗了多少推理预算。因此，官方发布应被理解为最终结构化样例，而不是公开的 BPP-Search 轨迹语料。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The work has two linked but distinct data objects. The released object is StructuredOR: 124 JSON records, split into 86 files under train/ and 38 under test/. Each record contains a question, a nested label, and an objective_value. The label organizes the final mathematical model into lists named set, parameter, variable, objective, and constraint; entries carry names, descriptions, data or domains where applicable, variable types and optional bounds, objective sense and function, and constraint functions. Optional-key variation exists across records.

The runtime object is a search tree that is not in the release. BPP-Search compresses mathematical modeling into four layers—question; sets plus parameters; variables; objective plus constraints. A Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B process reward model scores intermediate candidates for greedy or beam retention, and a separately fine-tuned Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B pairwise classifier ranks completed candidates. The public JSON keeps the selected endpoint and reference objective value, but not node text, topology, rejected branches, PRM scores, pairwise comparisons, checker outputs, or search budgets.

这项工作包含两个相互关联、但不能混为一谈的数据对象。公开对象是 StructuredOR：共 124 个 JSON 记录，其中 train/ 下 86 个文件，test/ 下 38 个文件。每条记录包含 question、嵌套的 label 和 objective_value。label 用 set、parameter、variable、objective、constraint 五个列表组织最终数学模型；其中按对象类型记录名称、描述、数据或定义域、变量类型与可选边界、目标方向与函数，以及约束函数。不同记录之间存在可选键差异。

运行时对象则是一棵未公开的搜索树。BPP-Search 把数学建模压缩为四层：问题；集合与参数；变量；目标与约束。一个基于 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 的过程奖励模型为中间候选打分，供贪心或 beam 保留；另一个独立微调的 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 成对分类器负责排序完整候选。公开 JSON 保留最终端点和参考目标值，但不包含节点文本、拓扑、被拒分支、PRM 分数、成对比较、检查器输出或搜索预算。

title: Method
方法
html:
StructuredOR starts from abstract operations-research models. The paper reports 77 examples from the prior framework and 47 examples created by changing parameter distributions. GPT-4o generates set and parameter distributions, problem descriptions, and three semantically equivalent rephrasings. Simulation instantiates concrete values; a parser and modeling tool construct a concrete linear program; Gurobi checks solvability and correctness; string insertion produces numerical questions. Manual review, GPT scoring, and rule-based evaluation filter rephrasings. Exact prompts, the GPT-4o snapshot, temperatures, parser and solver versions, decision thresholds, and stage-wise rejection counts are undisclosed.

For search, the original Q -> S -> P -> V -> O -> C modeling path is combined into Q -> SP -> V -> OC. Each node has at most three children in the described substrate. GPT-4o is the fixed policy model in the main BPP-Search comparisons. A binary Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B PRM uses the sigmoid of its “correct” logit as a continuous node score; beam search retains the highest-scoring intermediate candidates. Completed candidates are compared in both directions by a second binary classifier, their comparison scores are averaged, and the highest-scoring candidate is returned.

The selector-training recipe is described but its records are not released. PRM data come from GPT, Llama, and Qwen-family CoT or ToT outputs over StructuredOR, NL4OPT, and MAMO-ComplexLP training problems. Objective-value consistency labels paths; correct paths receive cumulative intermediate segmentation, an identified wrong step propagates incorrectness to later steps, and manual perturbations add positive and negative examples. Pairwise data are formed from objective-consistent and objective-inconsistent final paths, placed in both orders and labeled by the position of the correct path. The paper does not disclose corpus sizes, splits, optimizer settings, seeds, checkpoints, or calibration.

Search width is an explicit experimental setting. A complete height-4 tree with branching factor 3 requires 39 policy-model calls, and branching factor 4 would require 84. Reported width-2 and width-3 BPP-Search settings use 15 and 21 reasoning steps. These are aggregate configurations, not record-level logs; per-example calls, tokens, latency, cost, retries, and stopping decisions remain unknown.

StructuredOR 从抽象运筹优化模型出发。论文报告其中 77 个样例来自既有框架，另有 47 个样例通过改变参数分布生成。GPT-4o 生成集合与参数分布、问题描述和三个语义等价改写；仿真过程实例化具体数值；解析器与建模工具构造具体线性规划；Gurobi 检查可解性与正确性；字符串插入形成带数值的问题。改写结果再经过人工审核、GPT 打分和规则评估。论文没有披露精确提示、GPT-4o 版本、温度、解析器与求解器版本、判定阈值或各阶段拒绝数量。

搜索阶段把原始的 Q -> S -> P -> V -> O -> C 建模路径合并为 Q -> SP -> V -> OC。所述搜索基底中每个节点至多有三个子节点，主实验固定使用 GPT-4o 作为策略模型。一个二分类 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B PRM 把“correct”logit 的 sigmoid 当作连续节点分数，beam search 据此保留得分最高的中间候选。完整候选再由第二个二分类器按两个顺序成对比较；系统对每个候选的比较分数取平均，并返回最高分候选。

论文描述了选择器训练配方，但没有发布相应记录。PRM 数据来自 GPT、Llama 和 Qwen 系列模型在 StructuredOR、NL4OPT 与 MAMO-ComplexLP 训练题上生成的 CoT 或 ToT 输出。路径按目标值一致性标注：正确路径被累积切分为中间监督；定位到错误步骤后，后续步骤都继承错误标签；人工扰动补充正负样例。成对数据由目标值一致与不一致的最终路径组成，同一对按两个顺序排列，并以正确路径所在位置作为标签。语料规模、划分、优化器设置、随机种子、检查点与校准过程均未披露。

搜索宽度是明确的实验变量。高度为 4、分支因子为 3 的完整树需要 39 次策略模型调用，分支因子为 4 时需要 84 次。论文报告的 width-2 和 width-3 BPP-Search 配置分别使用 15 和 21 个推理步骤。这些是整体实验配置，不是逐样例日志；单例调用数、token、延迟、成本、重试与停止决策仍为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The paper reports 124 StructuredOR questions across ten domains: Agriculture 24, Logistics 20, Education 15, Sports 12, Military 12, Energy 12, Telecommunications 11, Manufacturing 9, Health Services 5, and Finance 4. At the pinned official Hugging Face revision, all 124 files parse as JSON, with 86 train and 38 test records. Their exact question strings are all unique and no exact string appears in both directories. That audit does not test semantic near-duplicates, shared templates, or parameter variants.

Search comparisons are conditional. The evaluation retains only problems for which fully traversed GPT-4o ToT produced at least one correct answer: 30 of 38 StructuredOR, 72 of 211 MAMO-ComplexLP, and 143 of 289 NL4OPT problems. Within these policy-solvable subsets, the paper reports that PRM-guided search and pairwise final selection improve accuracy and reduce traversal relative to the compared strategies. The reported wider-beam ablation is not monotonic: similar correct and incorrect candidates can receive similar PRM scores, and increasing beam width can reduce accuracy.

These experiments support claims about the proposed search stack under the reported conditional protocol. They do not establish the quality, coverage, or leakage resistance of the 124-row public dataset, and they do not independently validate the learned selectors. Because raw trees, selected and rejected nodes, checker outputs, scores, and per-example budgets are absent, the release cannot reproduce the causal path from additional search compute to the reported final result.

论文报告 StructuredOR 共含 124 个问题，覆盖十个领域：Agriculture 24、Logistics 20、Education 15、Sports 12、Military 12、Energy 12、Telecommunications 11、Manufacturing 9、Health Services 5、Finance 4。在锁定的官方 Hugging Face 修订版中，124 个文件均可解析为 JSON，其中训练集 86 条、测试集 38 条。所有 question 精确字符串互不重复，两个目录之间也没有精确字符串重合。但该审计并未检测语义近重复、共享模板或仅参数不同的变体。

搜索比较带有条件性。评测只保留完整遍历 GPT-4o ToT 后至少得到一个正确答案的问题：StructuredOR 为 30/38，MAMO-ComplexLP 为 72/211，NL4OPT 为 143/289。在这些策略模型可解的子集上，论文报告 PRM 引导搜索与最终成对选择相较所比较策略提高准确率并减少遍历。然而，更宽 beam 的消融并非单调改进：相似的正确与错误候选可能得到接近的 PRM 分数，增加 beam 宽度有时反而降低准确率。

这些实验支持在所报告条件协议下对搜索栈的论断，但不能证明 124 条公开数据的质量、覆盖度或抗泄漏能力，也不构成对学习式选择器的独立验证。由于原始树、入选与被拒节点、检查器输出、分数以及逐样例预算均未发布，公开材料无法复现从新增搜索计算到最终结果的因果路径。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The distinctive contribution is the coupling of a structured mathematical-modeling representation with two learned selection stages. Intermediate beam retention uses a process classifier, whereas final choice uses pairwise comparisons across completed candidates. This separates local process ranking from terminal candidate ranking instead of asking one scalar signal to serve both roles.

For data curation, the more important distinction is between the method object and the released object. StructuredOR makes the final sets, parameters, variables, objective, constraints, and objective value explicit, but the BPP-Search tree that produces a candidate is not preserved. The paper is therefore useful both as a search recipe and as an example of why a final-example release is not equivalent to a rollout or search-trace release.

这项工作的主要区别在于，把结构化数学建模表示与两个学习式选择阶段结合起来：中间 beam 保留由过程分类器决定，最终选择则通过完整候选之间的成对比较完成。这样，局部过程排序与终局候选排序由不同信号承担，而不是让单一标量同时完成两种任务。

对数据整理而言，更关键的区别是“方法对象”与“发布对象”并不相同。StructuredOR 明确记录最终集合、参数、变量、目标、约束和目标值，却没有保留产生候选的 BPP-Search 树。因此，这篇论文既是一项搜索配方，也说明了为什么“最终样例发布”不能等同于“rollout 或搜索轨迹发布”。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The public boundary is narrow. StructuredOR exposes 124 final question, structured-label, and objective-value objects, not raw trees, parent-child edges, visited or pruned branches, rejected candidates, final queues, objective or constraint checker outputs, solver logs, terminal-verdict provenance, PRM scores, pairwise scores, or per-example budgets. The official GitHub repository at the audited commit contains only README.md and LICENSE; it provides no search, parser, solver-validation, training, or evaluation implementation.

Reproducibility details are missing at several stages. The exact GPT-4o snapshot and prompts, sampling settings, retry and stopping rules, parser and Gurobi configuration, numerical tolerances, PRM and pairwise corpus sizes and splits, perturbation logs, optimizer hyperparameters, seeds, checkpoints, and calibration analyses are unknown. Matching a reference objective value is treated as path correctness, but objective agreement alone does not prove that every variable definition or constraint is semantically correct.

The dataset audit is also incomplete. Public records lack stable IDs and template, rephrasing, augmentation, and source-lineage fields. Split rationale, family-level isolation, semantic deduplication, and benchmark-overlap checks are undisclosed; the paper itself warns that parameter-only expansion can produce leakage and overfitting. The 124 checked questions have no exact cross-split duplicate, but that is not a semantic contamination test. The GitHub repository is MIT-licensed, while the separately hosted StructuredOR dataset license is unknown; the repository license must not be assumed to cover the data.

Finally, reported search accuracy is measured on GPT-4o-solvable subsets rather than full test sets. Search cost changes with width and depth, yet record-level compute is absent. Performance comparisons therefore should not be read as dataset-quality evidence or as an equal-budget causal estimate of the selectors’ contribution.

公开边界较窄。StructuredOR 只提供 124 条最终问题、结构化标签和目标值对象，不含原始树、父子边、访问或剪枝分支、被拒候选、最终队列、目标或约束检查器输出、求解器日志、终局判定来源、PRM 分数、成对分数或逐样例预算。经审计提交上的官方 GitHub 仓库只有 README.md 与 LICENSE，没有搜索、解析器、求解验证、训练或评测实现。

多个阶段缺少复现细节。精确的 GPT-4o 版本与提示、采样设置、重试与停止规则、解析器和 Gurobi 配置、数值容差、PRM 与成对语料规模及划分、扰动日志、优化器超参数、随机种子、检查点和校准分析均为 unknown。论文以参考目标值一致作为路径正确性，但目标值相同本身不能证明每个变量定义和约束在语义上都正确。

数据集审计也不完整。公开记录没有稳定 ID，也没有模板、改写、增强或来源谱系字段；划分依据、按家族隔离、语义去重与基准重合检查均未披露，论文还明确警告仅改变参数可能导致泄漏与过拟合。所检查的 124 个问题不存在跨划分精确重复，但这不是语义污染测试。GitHub 仓库采用 MIT license，单独托管的 StructuredOR 数据集 license 则为 unknown，不能把代码仓库许可推定为数据许可。

最后，搜索准确率是在 GPT-4o 可解子集而非完整测试集上报告的。搜索成本随宽度和深度变化，但没有逐记录计算量。因此，性能比较不能被当作数据集质量证据，也不能被当作等预算条件下选择器贡献的因果估计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the assigned rollout/search/test-time-trace track, BPP-Search provides a concrete decomposition of the search feedback contract: parser and Gurobi checks help construct solvable instances; objective-value consistency labels paths; a learned PRM ranks intermediate nodes; and a learned pairwise model selects the final candidate. Its width and full-tree call counts make inference budget a visible design variable.

The public StructuredOR rows may be studied as final structured mathematical-modeling examples, subject to the unknown dataset license and unresolved lineage. The paper’s described PRM and pairwise recipes are relevant to process supervision, reward modeling, preference learning, evaluation, and test-time search, but the underlying selector corpora and checkpoints are unavailable. Consequently, the release should not be registered or used as if it contained negative rollouts, raw tree supervision, or replayable verifier traces.

As an audit case, the card identifies the minimum additions needed for a reusable search artifact: stable record and family IDs; all nodes and edges; selected, pruned, and rejected branches; checker and solver outputs; PRM and pairwise scores; terminal reasons; prompts and model revisions; and per-example policy, verifier, token, latency, and stopping budgets. Those missing fields are central data requirements for this track, not optional implementation detail.

对于指定的“Rollout / Search / Test-Time Trace Data”方向，BPP-Search 给出了一套具体的搜索反馈分解：解析器与 Gurobi 检查用于构造可解实例；目标值一致性用于标注路径；学习式 PRM 排序中间节点；学习式成对模型选择最终候选。论文报告的宽度和完整树调用次数还把推理预算显式化为设计变量。

在数据集 license 为 unknown 且谱系未解决的前提下，公开 StructuredOR 可作为最终结构化数学建模样例进行研究。论文描述的 PRM 与成对配方与过程监督、奖励建模、偏好学习、评测和测试时搜索有关，但相应选择器语料和检查点并未提供。因此，不能把这份发布登记或使用成包含负 rollout、原始树监督或可重放验证器轨迹的数据集。

作为审计案例，本卡片列出可复用搜索数据至少需要补充的字段：稳定记录 ID 与家族 ID；全部节点和边；入选、剪枝和被拒分支；检查器与求解器输出；PRM 与成对分数；终止原因；提示与模型修订版；以及逐样例的策略调用、验证调用、token、延迟和停止预算。这些缺失项是本方向的核心数据要求，而非可有可无的实现细节。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep the two objects separate: StructuredOR releases 124 final rows (86 train, 38 test), whereas BPP-Search operates on unreleased runtime trees.
  • Read the public row as question + nested label (set, parameter, variable, objective, constraint) + objective_value; do not infer node or checker fields.
  • Interpret the search results on their stated GPT-4o-solvable subsets: 30/38 StructuredOR, 72/211 MAMO-ComplexLP, and 143/289 NL4OPT.
  • Treat 39 calls for branching factor 3, 84 for branching factor 4, and 15/21 steps for widths 2/3 as experiment-level budgets, not per-record metadata.
  • Audit the release boundary first: raw trees, pruned and rejected nodes, selector corpora and scores, checker outputs, implementation, per-example budgets, and the dataset license are absent or unknown.

• 区分两个对象：StructuredOR 发布 124 条最终记录（训练 86、测试 38），BPP-Search 则运行在未发布的搜索树上。
  • 公开记录的结构是 question + 嵌套 label（set、parameter、variable、objective、constraint）+ objective_value；不要推定其中存在节点或检查器字段。
  • 按论文注明的 GPT-4o 可解子集解释搜索结果：StructuredOR 30/38、MAMO-ComplexLP 72/211、NL4OPT 143/289。
  • 分支因子 3 的 39 次调用、分支因子 4 的 84 次调用，以及宽度 2/3 的 15/21 个步骤都是实验级预算，不是逐记录元数据。
  • 首先审计发布边界：原始树、剪枝与被拒节点、选择器语料及分数、检查器输出、实现、逐样例预算和数据集 license 均缺失或为 unknown。
